content: In Nahum, against which city is the burden of the prophet?
explanation: Jonah had once preached there too. “This is the burden against Nineveh” (Nahum 1:1, BSB)

content: In Nahum, the LORD is good and a stronghold in the day of what?
explanation: He cares for those who trust Him. “The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress” (Nahum 1:7, BSB)

content: In Nahum, the LORD is slow to anger and great in what?
explanation: He will punish the guilty. “The LORD is slow to anger and great in power” (Nahum 1:3, BSB)

content: In Nahum, what are the clouds beneath the LORD's feet?
explanation: His path is in the storm. “and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.” (Nahum 1:3, BSB)

content: In Nahum, for whom does the LORD care?
explanation: He is a stronghold. “He cares for those who trust in Him.” (Nahum 1:7, BSB)

content: In Nahum, where was the prophet Nahum from?
explanation: He is called the Elkoshite. “the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite” (Nahum 1:1, BSB)

content: In Nahum, what does the prophet call Nineveh?
explanation: It was full of lies and plunder. “Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder” (Nahum 3:1, BSB)
